text_blocks.snippet: The Moderna COVID-19 vaccine, also known as Spikevax, is a vaccine developed to protect against COVID-19. It was authorized for emergency use by the FDA in 2024 and is now fully approved for use in individuals 6 months and older. The 2024-2025 formula targets the Omicron variant KP.2 strain.

list.title: Development:
list.snippet: The vaccine was developed by Moderna in collaboration with the U.S. National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases and the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority.

list.title: Formula:
list.snippet: The 2024-2025 formula is a monovalent (single) vaccine targeting the Omicron variant KP.2 strain.

list.title: Approval:
list.snippet: While initially authorized for emergency use, the FDA has granted full approval for Spikevax in children aged 6 months through 11 years at increased risk for COVID-19 disease, according to Moderna Investor Relations. Spikevax is also approved for all adults 65 years and older.

list.title: Target Population:
list.snippet: The vaccine is authorized for use in individuals aged 6 months and older.
